comment: Plugins the repo does NOT own, recorded as recipes rather than vendored — same rationale as vendor.json. `claude-plugins sync` installs anything missing and sets the enabled flags; `claude-plugins capture` adopts whatever you added via /plugin. This file owns the ALWAYS-ON baseline; mode-specific plugins live in config/mode-configs/ and are switched by use-claude / use-glm.

zai-coding-plugins.note: An npx cache path, so it will not exist on a fresh machine — run `npx @z_ai/coding-helper` first, then re-run sync. Only the marketplace is recorded: the plugins it serves (glm-plan-usage, glm-plan-bug) are mode-scoped in config/mode-configs/glm-2.template.json, not part of the baseline.
